reviews.title: Rigged for Top Spenders. Banned Over Rushed Update Bugs.
reviews.text:
Do not waste your time or money on this game. The developers are constantly pushing out rushed updates and new developments, which have introduced severe technical bugs. 

The game constantly suffers from disconnect and reconnect issues during completely normal, legitimate gameplay. To make matters worse, the company heavily favors an inner circle of top-paying players and community moderators. This select group receives priority support, exclusive leaks, and early feature access, giving them an unfair competitive advantage.

My account was permanently restricted following an abnormal World Boss result on version 4.1.0. The support team flatly claimed that network instability and disconnect/reconnect loops cannot alter damage or bypass the 90-second instance timer. That is factually wrong. During severe network desyncs which have multiplied due to their constant, unstable updates a player can get stuck trying to reconnect for 7 to 8 minutes while the game continues recording inputs well past the standard clock, creating an inflated result. This was completely accidental and not purposely done or exploited. None of my other scores on any other leaderboards were ever anywhere near the top positions. Even I saw the final result was completely abnormal and questioned it, but naturally assumed it was just a temporary visual bug or glitch in their broken system.

Instead of acknowledging that their own constantly shifting software malfunctions under poor network conditions, they lazily label legitimate players as cheaters to protect their high-rolling inner circle. They would rather permanently strip away an account someone spent countless hours and real money on than admit their rushed updates have flaws.

To the Management Team: Punishing normal players for network-driven software errors while granting immunity and privileges to your favorite top spenders is a terrible business practice. I am looking for a fair reinstatement of my account. I will gladly update this review to reflect a positive experience once this restriction is lifted. 

(Account ID: 75DUOIRWOw0p2IDNEoWkrfnE930N)

reviews.title: Amazing game. Bright future.
reviews.text: Eternal Hero is one of the few mobile games that keeps me coming back. The developer does a great job pushing out new content and listening to the player base. The dev is active on discord and the community is great. If you enjoy games with professions, clans, dungeons, global chat, open world boss fights, quests, etc.. this is your game. I’ve played for about a year now and will continue to do so. My suggestions for the dev: Many players quit the game due to p2w aspects or micro-transactions that really don’t need to be there. Making it so a player doesn’t have to pay $15 to remove ads or to pay for the hero pass for some basic QoL functions like “claim all” or “auto-salvage” will help retain many players. I see some strides are being made to address this. I hope things continue to go in the right direction. I don’t think any items should be blocked by a paywall like the event items. Everything should be able to be earned. Sure, allow people to pay for quicker progression but give f2p players the option to earn everything as long as they’re commited! Anyways, great game, try it out. Excited for the future!

reviews.title: Great idea, terrible monetization.
reviews.text:
The game starts out fun and F2P friendly, but progression becomes much slower later on while the shop offers passes, gear packs, extra attempts and resources to speed things up. The difference between F2P and paying players becomes much more noticeable in higher level and competitive content.
It’s disappointing because the portrait one handed gameplay is genuinely great and the game has a lot of potential. I just wish progression was more balanced and less dependent on paid shortcuts.

reviews.title: Eternium fans will LOVE
reviews.text:
Game is very fun. The full grind is years long just a heads up. If thats your thing, you found it. Only one issue with the game. Free to play works. Plenty of 100% optional 5:15:30 second ads for small boosts. It is very fun. But after a month or two, you will be at a severe disadvantage without a $15-$20 dollar purchase, the auto loot pet. Then the hero passes being $4.99/$9.99 per 6 week season is also pretty steep especially when the $9.99 gives auto salvage a vital tool for mid-late game. Labor pass, $9.99/30 days. And then prices in game for resources are unbelievable. It goes on and on. This game would be 5/5 stars. But prices are 25-75% too high. Nerfed F2P auto loot and salvage pets are needed. 5&10 P charms each.
Avoid if you do not want to spend at least $20 to just be able to play efficiently after one month. Play if you don’t mind spending $120+/year on a mobile game.

reviews.title: A truly F2P game!
reviews.text:
Let me just start this out by saying that I’m a very cheap person who doesn’t like paying money for mobile games. That being said I have been playing since about 6 months after release and I am in the top few hundred on the leaderboard and It’s all from playing for free just in spare free time.

Be warned this game does have aspects like every single other mobile game where you can pay money for resources to advance faster, but the difference compared to thousands of other games is that you don’t have to. 

You can acquire pretty much everything that the P2W players can and you are never held back in this game. Pretty much each and every single important or OP item in this game can be acquired just by playing. You of course have to work or grind for them but the fact that you are not being left out just because you don’t want to spend tons of money on a game is really a gem.

Constant updates and events also keep the game interesting and there is also a very helpful community that is very new player friendly.

As someone who has downloaded and tried countless mobile games this one is really a gem.
